newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates fall on rate cut, low demand.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates fall on rate cut, low demand.

text.p: Bulgaria's interbank deposit rates fell from Friday levels due to a cut in the central bank main lev interest rate and low demand for funds, dealers said.
"Banks' liquidity is high and they are ready to lower their lending rates whenever demand arises," said a bank dealer.
Overnight depo rates eased to 1.50-1.75 percent annual from 1.75-2.0 percent on Friday. Spot week rates were around 3.0-3.5 percent annually, down from 3.5-4.0 percent.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.82 percent on Friday, down from 2.22 percent on Thursday, a central bank official said.
The central bank cut its simple annual main interest rate to 5.42 percent from 6.12 percent, effective from Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
